response.sql: WITH matched_orders AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () as share, order_count / AVG(order_count) OVER () as count_div_avg FROM matched_orders
